skills.name: Adamant Pot Power!
skills.description: Charges forward with an adamant pot. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

skills.name: Monster Cuisine Preparation
skills.description: Prepares dishes made from monsters. Good effects on allies.  *HP +290% (10 sec) *Evade Rate +30% (10 sec) *Reflects 170% of incoming skill damage as physical damage (10 sec) *Reflects 170% of incoming skill damage as magic damage (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Delicious in Dungeon
abilities.description: Delicious in Dungeon Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)
